received_works.body:
Good day.
I love your art but have no idea who to request!
so please feel free to check my account for all the vtubers I have requested art for and pick one to draw!

I want you to read the available lines. This is the line of a young, gentle, 18-year-old girl named Sena. She is saying goodbye to a female friend of the same age named Lia.

https://imgur.com/nqgJ03B

====================

また会える日が来たらいいですね、リアちゃん。春の陽ざしの中で、ネモフィラが咲く場所で。

Good day.
As I checked your account you do gacha for art.
so please feel free to check my account for all the vtubers I have requested art for and pick one to draw!

あかしけ　やなげ　緋色の鳥よ

くさはみ　ねはみ　けをのばせ
